sections.h2: Tracking Under Qatar's Data Protection Law

paragraphs.text: Qatar was the first country in the region to pass a national data privacy law: Law No. 13 of 2016, known as the PDPPL. Today it is administered by the National Data Privacy Office within the National Cyber Security Agency (NCSA). Firms in the Qatar Financial Centre follow a separate regime, the QFC Data Protection Regulations.

paragraphs.html: For SEO, this mainly affects how your website tracks visitors and handles form data. We set up Google Analytics 4 with a clear consent banner, a plain privacy notice and lead forms that ask only for what you need. See the official guidance from the NCSA. We are not lawyers, so your legal adviser should review your privacy notice.
